description: This file defines the Bigint class used for manipulating 64-bit integer values through byte array representations, including initialization, addition, and value extraction methods.

classes.name: Bigint
classes.description: A class to represent and operate on 64-bit integers using byte arrays, supporting initialization, addition, and value retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a Bigint instance, initializing bytes from an integer value.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Static method to create a Bigint instance initialized with a given integer.

methods.name: fromLowHigh
methods.description: Creates a Bigint from low and high 32-bit parts.

methods.name: getHigh32
methods.description: Retrieves the high 32 bits of the Bigint.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves an integer value from a segment of the byte array.

methods.name: getLowFF
methods.description: Returns the low 'FF' value as a float, possibly forcing overflow check.

methods.name: isOver32
methods.description: Checks whether the Bigint exceeds 32-bit limit or is set to force.

methods.name: getLow32
methods.description: Retrieves the low 32 bits as an integer.

methods.name: getHex64
methods.description: Returns the hexadecimal string representation of the 64-bit value.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds another Bigint to this Bigint, returning a new instance or throwing an OverflowException if overflow occurs.

methods.name: fillBytes
methods.description: Fills the internal byte array with the byte representation of a given integer.
